verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no user-definable event-to-action rules. The only related items are manual toggles like performance mode and Do Not Disturb, and built-in system defaults such as systemd-oomd, which are fixed behaviors rather than rules a user defines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
